proposals.before: In the second year, Marquis of Ping of Wu Xiao Jing became regional inspector of South Yanzhou and took Ziye on as recorder for the Champion General; when the headquarters was transferred, the appointment ended.
proposals.after: In the second year, Marquis of Wuping Xiao Jing became regional inspector of South Yanzhou and took Ziye on as recorder for the Champion General; when the headquarters was transferred, the appointment ended.
proposals.reason: 吳平侯 is the title Marquis of Wuping, not 'Marquis of Ping of Wu'.

proposals.before: At that time Marquis of Ping of Wu Xiao Mai and Zhang Zuan of Fanyang, whenever they discussed the classics and histories, would all defer to Ziye's judgment.
proposals.after: At that time Marquis of Wuping Xiao Mai and Zhang Zuan of Fanyang, whenever they discussed the classics and histories, would all defer to Ziye's judgment.
proposals.reason: 吳平侯 should be rendered Marquis of Wuping, matching the title form.

proposals.before: His grandfather Xu Pingdao had been regional inspector of Hailing under the Song.
proposals.after: His grandfather Xu Pingdao had been governor of Hailing under the Song.
proposals.reason: 太守 is a commandery governor (taishou), not regional inspector (刺史).

proposals.before: His grandfather Pingdao was regional inspector of Hailing under Song.
proposals.after: His grandfather Pingdao was governor of Hailing under Song.
proposals.reason: Literal English also mistranslates 太守 as regional inspector.

proposals.before: In modeling oneself on Ziyou and Zizhang, following in the footsteps of Yan Hui and Zigong, and combining literary talent with moral conduct — all of this we see in Pei Jiyuan.
proposals.after: In modeling oneself on Ziyou and Zixia, following in the footsteps of Yan Hui and Min Ziqian, and combining literary talent with moral conduct — all of this we see in Pei Jiyuan.
proposals.reason: Chinese 游、夏 are Confucius's literary disciples Ziyou (子游) and Zixia (子夏), not Zizhang (子張); 回、騫 are Yan Hui (顏回) and Min Ziqian (閔子騫), not Zigong (子貢). The literal line correctly has You/Xia and Yan/Qian.

decisions.reason: s0020 吳平侯蕭景 titles Xiao Jing 吳平侯, the Marquis of Wuping (place-name Wuping + hou), not 'Marquis of Ping of Wu'; the proposed idiomatic corrects that parsing error.
s0053 吳平侯蕭勱 likewise uses the title 吳平侯 for Xiao Mai; 'Marquis of Ping of Wu' misparses the fief name, and Marquis of Wuping is the accurate rendering.
s0129 宋海陵太守 names Pingdao 海陵太守 (commandery governor); 太守 is not 刺史, so replacing 'regional inspector' with 'governor' is required.
s0129 宋海陵太守 has the same office term in the literal field; 'regional inspector' wrongly equates 太守 with 刺史, and 'governor of Hailing' restores the correct office.
s0201 憲章游、夏，祖述回、騫 pairs 游/夏 as Ziyou and Zixia and 回/騫 as Yan Hui and Min Ziqian; the before text invents Zizhang and Zigong, and the proposed idiomatic matches the Chinese and the correct literal.
